in_sanskrit.name: Dipok
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Luminous, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dipok एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning 'lamp' or 'light'. The name Dipok signifies a radiant or luminous being, often associated with wisdom and knowledge in Hindu tradition.

in_hindi.name: दिपोक
in_hindi.meaning: दिप: light, ओक: to open, क: masculine suffix
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who brings light and opens things
